name: Adept solver
plain: A deterministic multistep in sigma space with a compensated derivative history and an optional Heun corrector. Adds clamps on extreme derivatives, NaN recovery, and dynamic thresholding when cond_scale exceeds 7.
math:
Order 2: d̃=d+c(d−d₋₁), c from compute_compensation_ratio(h,i,N). Order 3: r=h₀/h₁, c0=1+r/2, c1=−r/2, c2=0, normalized, d̃=c0d+c1d₋₁+c2d₋₂. x_pred=x+d̃dt.
Corrector: x=x+½(d+d_pred)dt, except last step. Dynamic thresholding at percentile 0.995 on x0 when cond_scale>7. Clamp |d| at 1000(1+σ/10).
label: from code
surprise: Thresholding triggers from a cond_scale value read in extra_args, so it fires only if the caller passes that key.
